clips.caption:
A farmer's horse ran off. Everyone said what rotten luck. Two days later it came back leading ten wild horses home with it. Now he was rich.

His son tried to break one of the new horses, got thrown, and broke his leg. Everyone said what rotten luck. Then the army came through the village taking every able-bodied young man to war - every one except the boy with the broken leg.

Good luck, bad luck. You don't actually know which one you're living through until the story is finished.
